id.description: Unique identifier for the character, e.g. c1, c2, or narrator

aliases.description: Alternative names or nicknames used in the text

gender.description: Character gender (e.g. female, male, non-binary, unknown)

age.description: Character age or life stage (e.g. child, young adult, adult, elderly)

voiceTraits.description: Vocal qualities (e.g. bright, witty, deep, raspy, calm)

start.description: 0-indexed character start offset (inclusive) within paragraph text

end.description: 0-indexed character end offset (exclusive) within paragraph text

speaker.description: Character ID matching a character in characters list, or 'narrator'

style.description: Emotional delivery style, e.g. 'calm, wry', 'teasing, amused', or null
